one_liner: Jimmy Butler III scores 21.5 points per 36 minutes on 50.6 percent from the field over 152 games.
three_things: The scoring is efficient rather than high-volume: 21.5 points per 36 minutes on 50.6 percent shooting.
He contributes across the board with 6.0 rebounds and 5.7 assists per 36 minutes.
Free-throw touch is strong at 85.5 percent.
context_note: Numbers are per-36-minute rates over a 3-season sample (seasons_played: 3), not per-game and not a full career; the manifest is descriptive_only, with no adjustment for opponent, teammates, role, or shot difficulty and a career_min_minutes>=800 inclusion floor. A lower per-36 scoring rate reflects role and shot volume, not necessarily lower impact.
